# Tecton icons — external

```tsx
import { WellIcon } from "@tecton/react/icons"
```

Every glyph takes the Lucide props plus `variant="outlined" | "filled"`; inside a control it carries `data-icon="inline-start"`.

- `ChristmasTreeIcon` — wellhead 'christmas tree' valve stack: vertical pipe with stacked crossbars
- `DrillBitIcon` — drill bit: tapered bit head with shank
- `FaultIcon` — diagonal line with offset crossing segment (geologic fault)
- `GeobodiesIcon` — cluster of three hexagons
- `GeostructureIcon` — irregular hexagon-like blob outline (geologic structure)
- `HorizonIcon` — single wave line (seismic horizon)
- `LogCurveIcon` — vertical zig-zag curve (well log trace)
- `OilRigOffshoreIcon` — offshore platform: derrick on deck over water
- `RockFormationsIcon` — triangle with layered strata lines (rock formations)
- `SeismicIcon` — horizontal line over concentric arcs (seismic reflection)
- `StrataIcon` — stacked layers with colored (pink-orange gradient) top layer
- `SurfaceIcon` — curved 3D mesh/grid surface
- `TrajectoryIcon` — curve from vertical to horizontal (well trajectory)
- `ValveIcon` — valve symbol: pipe with T-handle stem
- `VelocityModelIcon` — upward arrow through layered arcs (velocity model)
- `WellIcon` — wellhead symbol: vertical line with two short side bars
- `WellPickIcon` — vertical line crossed by a horizontal pick marker with dot
- `WellPlanIcon` — dotted vertical line with wellhead symbol (planned well)

Docs: /docs/icons
